name: attraction-inc

nodes.name: Studio Frontend
nodes.description: Jameo & Attraction Studio (same React app, tenant build) incl. the design editor and Speculoos

nodes.name: Attraction Website
nodes.description: Public multilingual marketing & product-discovery site (static product pages from Fibra)

nodes.name: Multiplayer
nodes.description: WebSocket presence and real-time collaboration (DynamoDB connection state)

nodes.name: Render Service
nodes.description: Stateless server-side WebGL rendering for artwork, previews and backend PDFs

nodes.name: Design State
nodes.description: Design records, mutations, product definitions and preview images (DynamoDB/S3)

nodes.name: Asset Manager
nodes.description: Python/FastAPI: uploads, artwork authorization, image processing, stitch estimates

nodes.name: Studio Backend
nodes.description: Users, teams, roles/permissions, orders, pricing, techpacks, sessions (Postgres)

nodes.name: Fibra · Public API
nodes.description: Catalogue, inventory, public API (api.attraction.com), MCP, Prextra syncs, distribution

nodes.name: Specs Service
nodes.description: Specs revisions (Speculoos), runtime merge, publish of public/private specs.json

nodes.name: Baseline Specs
nodes.description: Legacy versioned baseline specs.json (products, decorations, pricing) in private S3

nodes.name: Prextra ERP
nodes.description: Company ERP; system of record for inventory, posts product/inventory/pricing syncs

nodes.name: Distributors
nodes.description: SAGE Connect CA/US, ASI/ESP+, PromoStandards consumers

nodes.name: WebGL Decorations
nodes.description: @attraction-inc/webgl-decorations: the Generator (renders designs) for Studio & Render Service

nodes.name: Specs Validation
nodes.description: @attraction-inc/specs-validation: specs contracts shared by Frontend and Specs Service

nodes.name: Studio Translations
nodes.description: @attraction-inc/studio-translations for Frontend, Backend, Fibra; validates specs labels

nodes.name: PDF Maker
nodes.description: Typst techpacks, mockups and client proofs generated for Backend

nodes.name: AWS Infra
nodes.description: Shared AWS infrastructure (ca-central-1 + us-east-1), internal Slack automations

nodes.name: Workspace
nodes.description: Local integration stack (docker-compose), architecture docs, scripts

nodes.name: Live E2E
nodes.description: Playwright smoke tests against deployed Studios (staging & prod)

notes: Studio (frontend + backend) runs one tenant per brand. The Jameo tenant is used by clients (customer-facing). The Attraction tenant is only available to Attraction admins and staff, never to clients: a change that only affects the Attraction tenant is `internal`.
